'''The Store''', also known as '''Gerik's''', was a general store that operated during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The store was ran by the individual [[Gerik]] and was located in the settlement [[Dalia (township)|Dalia]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]]. It did a lot of trading with offworlders.<ref name="COL" />
